commits.message:
mcp_tools: default pdsx reads to phi's repo

pdsx falls back to the x-atproto-repo header when list_records or
get_record get no repo. DeepSeek passed repo=null nine times in one run;
those reads now go to phi's own repo instead of erroring.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

encounter_recovery: complete a scan at the last completed scan's coverage

Since 2026-10-20 phi's notification history has been longer than the
twenty-page bound, so every scan failed even when only 77 events were new.
A scan now records the start of the last completed scan (less a listing
margin) and completes once a page reaches events indexed before it; with
no completed scan, the bound still fails the scan. Hitting the bound logs
a warning instead of a traceback.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
